name: Damage Hornets
description: Deal as much damage to Hornets as possible within the raid time limit.
tip: Aggro Snitches to force extra Hornet spawns. Pilgrim's Peak on Blue Gate offers great elevation.

name: Damage Wasps
description: Deal damage to Wasps across any map.
tip: Wasps are common across all areas. Use Snitch alarms to spawn them in groups.

name: Damage Bastions
description: Deal damage to Bastions, the heavy shielded ARC enemies.
tip: Bastions have heavy armor. Bring high-damage weapons like the Anvil IV or Hullcracker.

name: Damage Rocketeers
description: Deal damage to Rocketeers found across all expeditions.
tip: Rocketeers fire explosive projectiles — keep your distance and use cover.

name: Damage Leapers
description: Deal damage to Leapers, fast-moving ARC enemies.
tip: Leapers are quick. Use shotguns or SMGs for close-range encounters.

name: Damage Bombardiers
description: Deal damage to Bombardiers, the large ARC threats.
tip: Bombardiers always have two Spotters with them. Deal with Spotters first.

name: Damage Queens or Matriarchs
description: Deal damage to Queens or Matriarchs — the most dangerous ARC.
tip: These are boss-tier ARCs. Bring a full squad and heavy firepower.

name: Damage Spotters
description: Deal damage to Spotters that accompany Bombardiers.
tip: Find Bombardiers — each one always has two Spotters with it.

name: Damage Rocketeers, Leapers or Bastions
description: Deal damage to any combination of Rocketeers, Leapers or Bastions.
tip: All three ARC types count — focus on whichever you find first.

name: Damage Ground-Based ARC Enemies
description: Damage any ARC enemies that are ground-based.
tip: Ground ARCs include Ticks, Leapers, and Bastions. Very easy to farm on any map.

name: Damage Flying ARC Enemies
description: Deal damage to flying ARC enemies on any map.
tip: Hornets, Wasps, and Snitches all count. Climb to high ground for better angles.

name: Damage Flying ARC Inside Spaceport Walls
description: Damage flying ARC enemies specifically inside the Spaceport walls.
tip: Stay inside the Spaceport walls — damage dealt outside won't count.

name: Destroy Ticks
description: Destroy Tick ARC units found across all maps.
tip: Ticks are small ground ARCs. One melee hit destroys them with the right skill.

name: Destroy Ticks, Fireballs and Pops
description: Destroy Ticks, Fireballs and Pop ARC units.
tip: All three small ARC types count. Easy to chain together in dense ARC areas.

name: Destroy Fireballs
description: Destroy Fireball ARC units.
tip: Fireballs explode on contact — keep your distance when shooting them.

name: Destroy Pops
description: Destroy Pop ARC units found in expedition areas.
tip: Pops are small and fast. Listen for their audio cues to locate them.

name: Destroy ARC Enemies in the Swamp
description: Destroy ARC enemies in the Swamp area on Dam Battlegrounds.
tip: The Swamp is in the Dam Battlegrounds map. Only kills here count.

name: Harvest Plants
description: Harvest plants found across all expedition maps.
tip: Plants are abundant on all maps. Run gathering routes for maximum efficiency.

name: Deliver Carriables
description: Deliver carriable items to extraction or deposit points.
tip: Carriables can be found near events and POIs. Deliver them to the extraction ship.

name: Open ARC Probes
description: Open ARC Probes found scattered across maps.
tip: ARC Probes are scattered across all maps. Listen for their distinct hum.

name: Search Raider Caches
description: Search hidden Raider Caches scattered around maps.
tip: Raider Caches are hidden in spots other players have died. Check popular combat areas.

name: Search First Wave Husks
description: Search First Wave Husk containers on any map.
tip: First Wave Husks are skeletal remains with loot. Found near buildings and shelters.

name: Loot Bird's Nests
description: Loot bird's nests found in elevated positions.
tip: Bird's nests are in high places — on rooftops, towers, and cliffs.

name: Search Containers in Medical Research Wing
description: Search containers inside the Medical Research wing on Stella Montis.
tip: Medical Research is on Stella Montis. Watch out for Shredders guarding the area.

name: Open Containers in Traffic Tunnels
description: Open containers inside the traffic tunnels during Locked Gate on Blue Gate.
tip: Only available during the Locked Gate event on Blue Gate.

name: Disarm Mines During Locked Gate
description: Disarm mines at 4 main locations during the Locked Gate event on Blue Gate.
tip: Mines appear in 4 main locations during Locked Gate. Approach carefully.

name: Download Information Inside Bunker
description: Download information from terminals inside the Hidden Bunker.
tip: Only available during the Hidden Bunker event on Spaceport.

name: Get Hit by Lightning
description: Get hit by lightning during Electromagnetic storm events.
tip: Only during Electromagnetic events. Stand on high ground and metal structures.

name: Deal Damage to Shredders
description: Deal damage to Shredder ARC enemies.
tip: Shredders are found on Stella Montis. Bring heavy weapons and shields.
